decision: Reject the full FIFO-check GX source experiment; its isolated candidate changes serialized RAM, FIFO and event-order state. Do not ship this patched core. The source was already reversed in the private active vendor checkout; retain the text patch for reproducibility only.
limits: Matching sampled fighter/controller fingerprints does not prove scene or machine-state equivalence. Different compiled-core source means its byte count cannot be compared directly to the older core's saved-state size. No candidate FPS uplift was measured.
